headline_finding: The 1024-sample batch passed to Predictor.predict is the single most underexplored degree of freedom — within-batch quantiles/moments give a free, stateless, sym-agnostic, shuffle-robust adaptive threshold (BAT/CSSC). Combined with quantile-spread t-stat gating (QSA, reusing T86 models on disk) and intraday schedule (IDS, using legal `time` field), there is a 1.5-day path to +3~+5 LOSO over iter_014.

top5.name: BAT — Batch-Adaptive Threshold
top5.mechanism: Within each predict() call, compute quantile(preds, 1-alpha_up) and use as threshold. Hybrid with absolute floor.
top5.risk: medium - batch composition assumed representative; mitigated via abs floor
top5.rationale: Rank-based gate is invariant to model output drift (location-shift) — the dominant failure mode for fixed thresholds when sym/date distribution shifts.

top5.name: QSA — Quantile-Spread Abstain
top5.mechanism: Use T86 q30, q70 to compute mu, sigma per row; gate on t-stat |mu/sigma| > z*. Combine with EV gate as additional veto.
top5.risk: low - models exist on disk; pure inference change
top5.rationale: T86 trained quantile models but used only the midpoint. The SPREAD is exactly the model's self-reported uncertainty — currently discarded. Best ROI in project.

top5.name: IDS — Intraday Schedule Threshold
top5.mechanism: Compute minute from `time` (last row of window); apply 5-knot piecewise threshold for open/close/midday.
top5.risk: very low - 5 params over physically-grounded prior
top5.rationale: date is zeroed but time is allowed. Strong physical prior on intraday volatility U-shape, low overfit risk.

top5.name: SCG — Spread-Conditioned EV Gate
top5.mechanism: thr_up = alpha_up + beta_up * spread1; analogously for thr_dn. Same 4D parameter count as current robust thresh.
top5.risk: low - replaces 4D DE params with theoretically-motivated alternative
top5.rationale: EV gate ignores per-row noise level. Spread is a direct measurement of bid-ask noise. The 4 DE parameters could be (T,beta) instead of (T,d) without raising overfit risk.

top5.name: HMD — Hybrid Multi-Model Direction-Veto
top5.mechanism: When LGB and NN disagree on sign(pred), abstain. When they agree, use weighted average for EV gate.
top5.requires: T87 NN integrated into Predictor (already on iter_015 critical path)
top5.risk: medium - veto could over-abstain on slow-converging signals
top5.rationale: Cross-corr T87-T75=0.71 → 30% disagreement room. Sign-veto is the discrete-decision analog of variance reduction. Marginal once T87 is in.

key_insight: Within-batch cross-sample statistics (BAT, CSSC) are the single most underexplored degree of freedom — sit on the API, fully red-line compliant, never used in T1-T98.
secondary_insight: T86 quantile spread is sitting unused on disk — was used as midpoint predictor only, never as uncertainty gate.
tertiary_insight: `time` is allowed (only `date` is zeroed) — intraday schedule is fair game and unused.
estimated_combined_lift_loso: +2.5 ~ +5.0 over iter_014 (BAT + QSA + IDS + SCG, conservatively additive)
execution_plan: Day 1: QSA + IDS (Predictor-only, ~6h). Day 2: BAT (calibrate on simulated 1024-batches). Day 3 (if budget): SCG. Submit as iter_016 candidate.
